categories.name: Gift
categories.desc: Your gift defines how you fight. Your first **spin** of the wheel is free, then it costs 🔴 huayruros (with 10 you can spin x10 and choose). **Pacts** give you power in exchange for a drawback and, from Lv 50, **reincarnating** gives you permanent bonuses.

commands.name: spin
commands.desc: Spin the wheel to get your gift (free the first time, then 1 🔴)

options.name: spins
options.desc: How many spins (x10: 10 🔴, you pick which one to keep)

commands.name: odds
commands.desc: See how likely each gift is on the wheel

commands.name: learn
commands.desc: Use a gift scroll (zone bosses drop them) to change your gift

commands.name: pact
commands.desc: Binding pacts: a drawback in exchange for power (no name: see the list)

commands.name: break-pact
commands.desc: Break your binding pact (you can't sign another one for a while)

commands.name: reincarnate
commands.desc: From Lv 50: go back to Lv 1 for a permanent damage and XP bonus

commands.name: daily

commands.name: hunt

commands.name: travel

options.name: bet

commands.name: supay

commands.name: spawns

commands.name: event
commands.desc: See the 20 souls event: leaderboard, time left and how to get them

commands.name: ranks

commands.name: top

categories.name: Nahuales
categories.desc:
Spirit companions you get with the 🧧 Summoning Seal from the shop, from the 👑 Salamanca bosses or, if you're lucky, while hunting.
• **Equip one** and its passive fights with you in every fight (hunting, Salamanca, duels, raids…).
• **Send the rest** on an **expedition** for 1, 4 or 8 h **to the zone you choose**: they come back with pesos, XP, relics and materials (some exclusive to each zone). In dangerous zones they can **die**: revive them with a 🪬 Resurrection Talisman.
• **Duplicate copies** are kept: fuse them to level up, sell them, gift them or trade them.

commands.name: nahuales
commands.desc: Your nahuales: see their passives and equip one to fight with you

commands.name: expedition
commands.desc: Send your nahuales on an expedition (1, 4 or 8 h) and collect what they bring

commands.name: fuse
commands.desc: Fuse duplicate copies of a nahual to level it up

options.name: nahual
options.desc: Which one (no name: see what you can fuse)

options.name: amount
options.desc: How many copies (default: as many as needed for max level)

commands.name: revive
commands.desc: Revive a nahual that fell on an expedition with a 🪬 Resurrection Talisman

categories.name: Gear and economy
categories.desc: **Relics** drop while hunting and in the Salamanca: equip them to hit harder and upgrade them up to +5. In the **shop** you spend pesos on items, combat consumables, boxes, nahuales, boosts and cosmetics (used with **customize**). With the **materials** you gather (and by dismantling relics) you **craft** consumables, seals, eggs and exclusive relics. With **gift** and **trade** you can pass anything around: pesos, huayruros, relics, nahuales, materials, consumables and collectibles.

commands.name: inventory
commands.desc: Your full inventory: relics, consumables, materials, nahuales and collection

commands.name: equip

commands.name: unequip
commands.desc: Remove the relic from a slot

commands.name: upgrade
